function: TD3 agent jointly learns BS beamforming vectors and STAR-RIS reflection and transmission coefficients to maximize the downlink sum rate (p. 3).
system: Downlink MISO: BS with 4 antennas, 4 single-antenna users (2 reflection side, 2 transmission side), STAR-RIS with 4 to 30 elements and energy splitting, 2.4 GHz (p. 4, 11).
method: TD3 actor-critic reinforcement learning with twin critics, target policy smoothing and delayed actor updates; trained by interaction with simulated fading channels (p. 7).
data_channel: Own simulation: i.i.d. Rayleigh fading channels H ~ CN(0, I) with unit path loss and optional estimation error; no 3GPP model or measured data (p. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated on random Rayleigh realizations of one model; one curve per transmit power, RIS size (4 to 30), learning rate and decay value (p. 10, 12).
baselines: Learned: DDPG [62] only (p. 13). No non-learned method is shown in the results; the abstract names a passive RIS benchmark (p. 1).
metrics: Cumulative average reward (sum rate), instantaneous reward, CDF of achievable sum rate as reliability, maximum sum rate versus RIS elements (p. 10, 13, 14).
complexity: Big-O order per step (environment O(LMK+LK^2), learning O(B(Pa+6Pc))) and total O(ET...) in Table 3 and Eqs. 47-53; no FLOP count or runtime (p. 9, 10, 11).
q1_support: p. 4: "Each channel is modeled as a complex Gaussian random" - i.i.d. Rayleigh fading with unit path loss (Table 2, p. 11); no 3GPP model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "Fig. 4 illustrates the training performance of the proposed" - one curve per transmit power, RIS size, learning rate and decay; the CDFs use realizations of the same Rayleigh model; no trained model is tested in a new scenario.
q3_support: p. 13: "PERFORMANCE COMPARISON BETWEEN DDPG [62]" and TD3 - the only baseline in the results is the learned DDPG; the abstract (p. 1) names a passive RIS benchmark that no figure, table or sentence of the results shows or defines, so no non-learned comparison is reported.
q4_support: p. 11: "Per-step computational complexity of TD3-based optimization framework" - Table 3, with the Big-O analysis of Section V (pp. 9, 10); no FLOP count or measured runtime.
q5_support: p. 10: "For the simulation setup, we consider a downlink multi-user" - simulated Rayleigh channels; no code, data link or public dataset is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 3: TD3 learns the BS precoder and the STAR-RIS coefficients, which is beamforming and RIS configuration. Tables 2 and 3 and all figures are not in the extracted text, so I read them from the page images (pp. 11, 13 to 15). q3 is 0 because the results compare only against DDPG [62], a learned method; the abstract also claims a gain over a passive RIS benchmark, but that benchmark appears in no result, so the reviewer should confirm this reading of q3. The system is a small one (4 antennas, 4 users, 4 RIS elements by default, up to 30).
